ev.q: In 2020, HIV diagnoses reported to CDC decreased by 17% compared with those reported in 2019.
In 2020, 30,635 diagnoses were reported to NHSS compared with 36,940 in 2019
HRSA UDS data indicated an 8.3% decrease in HIV screening tests.
CDC received reports of 17,007,063 total HIV screening tests from two commercial laboratories
These sources reported substantial decreases in the number of tests and positive results in 2020 compared with 2019.
CDC analyzed data from four national data collection systems to assess the numbers of HIV tests performed
in the years before (2019) and during (2020) the COVID-19 pandemic
to assess weekly changes in testing reported to NSSP from February 3, 2019

methods_quotes.q: For each data source, differences between 2019 and 2020 were calculated for both the absolute number and corresponding percentages of HIV tests conducted.
the total number of HIV antigen or antibody screening tests were summarized by the surveillance week
Differences in HIV testing by race and ethnicity and by population group were estimated from CDC NHM&E data
